This '''Keshiri''' was the wife of [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] resident [[Wertram]] and together they had a [[Wertram's daughter|daughter]]. Her husband worked as a tailor in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Tahv]]. Eventually, he placed their daughter under the tutelage of a prominent teacher and [[Geologist/Legends|geologist]], [[Adari Vaal]], a neighbor of theirs. There, her daughter learned controversial theories about the formation of Kesh's continents, contradicting the prevalent Keshiri [[Skyborn|religion]]. Although she never left her hut for anything, at one time she accompanied her husband in visiting Adari. They found only her mother, [[Eulyn]], and expressed their concern about her daughter's teachings.<ref name="Skyborn" />
